description: The official Mass Mobilization codebook/version, universe, schema and licensing gate remain pending; no original observation set is used to approve candidates.
required_followup: Coordinator to verify the current official baseline, original codebook and export mapping before any official integration.

description: Site-specific turnout is absent for both 10 Jan marches, the 17–18 Jan local blockades, the 31 Jan Cochabamba transport-sector counter-blockades, and Potosí/Santa Cruz women’s mobilizations. “Hundreds” of vehicles/affected road users is not protest turnout. EFE’s hundreds estimate applies only to the El Alto–La Paz women’s march.
required_followup: Seek contemporary site-specific counts or a clear qualitative crowd description; do not use regional totals or affected-traffic figures as attendance.

description: El Alto blockade accounts conflict: Correo del Sur reports an actual civic-committee block at Naciones Unidas on a second consecutive day; ERBOL says an attempted Naciones Unidas blockade was prevented; EJU/Página Siete reports two El Alto points; other accounts describe a blockade near the city boundary on Jan19. Sites, groups and times may differ.
required_followup: Compare site/time details and local reports to determine whether these were distinct groups/sites or conflicting accounts of one local action; retain pending evidence until resolved.

description: The K’ara K’ara action’s day-count reports support an attributed 17 Jan onset, but no body-read source establishes when the blockade physically ended. Search-only leads describe ten days on 27 Jan and police lifting the block on 1 Feb; their bodies remain unread.
required_followup: Read the 27 Jan El Deber and 1 Feb Los Tiempos pages if accessible; distinguish temporary police opening/resumption from a durable end and check February continuation ownership.

description: Several relevant page-body requests returned tool-only Cache miss; ordinary HTTPS to the same exact URL then failed DNS before HTTP. Other saved tool outcomes included URL-not-accessible. No observed denial was found for these attempts. Search-only cards remain distinct from body-read evidence.
required_followup: Revisit only via ordinary public retrieval after fresh receipts and full ledger review. A new observed denial/paywall/challenge stops retrieval; technical failure remains an access gap.

description: Spanish-language searches covered weekly/date slices and named local media/regions, but open web search does not reproduce LexisNexis or guarantee complete local coverage. Oruro, Potosí beyond Tacopalca, Sucre, Tarija, Santa Cruz outside Jan31, Beni and Pando remain thinly covered.
required_followup: Search additional regional newspapers, radio and official/rights records; distinguish no result from no event and do not claim exhaustiveness.

description: Search coverage is predominantly Spanish. Aymara, Quechua and other Indigenous-language reporting was not systematically searched or translated.
required_followup: Where accessible, search local-language reporting and request an independent human language review for relevant sources.

description: Most state-response fields remain unknown. At K’ara K’ara, police chemical-agent use and road-clearing attempts are reported, but dispersal of assembled persons is not established; the vaccine-card/PCR suspension is campaign-level context rather than a site-specific concession. Arrests, police beatings, firearm shootings and protest-linked killings are not established. EFE reports police inaction near a journalist assault in El Alto, but relation to the civic-committee action is unresolved.
required_followup: Seek site-specific police, prosecutor, Ombudsman and local reporting; do not transfer responses across locations or infer firearms/deaths from gas or injury reports.

description: The Jan18 Copacabana/El Alto/Tacopalca story and Jan20 government-response story on EJU explicitly attribute content to Página Siete; they are not independent EJU reporting. The Jan31 Los Tiempos page is ANF-origin; Swissinfo carries EFE. Preserve these origins and do not count republications as separate confirmation.
required_followup: Find exact original Página Siete article URLs only if needed, with a fresh source-access check; retain ANF/EFE origins separately.

description: The announced 13 Jan nationwide strike/blockades are not evidence of execution. The read Opinión story records only an announcement; actual Jan17–19 local blockades are separately dated. A Jan15 Santa Cruz cabildo suspension story remains search-only.
required_followup: If relevant, obtain readable contemporary bodies for the cabildo and planned Jan13 action and verify execution/date before adding or excluding an event.

description: For the 31 Jan women’s-rights actions, EFE estimates hundreds only for the El Alto–La Paz route. ANF separately reports Potosí and Santa Cruz acts without local counts. No turnout transfers among the three cities.
required_followup: Find local reports with turnout and route/end details for Potosí and Santa Cruz; keep them pending threshold.

description: Open-web searches may prioritize the anti-certificate blockades and Jan31 march. Cross-sector and local-language review remains incomplete, so no absence claim can be made for the remainder of January.
required_followup: Continue targeted weekly searches for health, education, labor, transport, mining, rural/agricultural, Indigenous and neighborhood action, especially in regions with sparse results.

description: Opinión reports Cochabamba transport-sector blockades active on the morning of 31 Jan at multiple points, but does not establish exact physical onset/end, turnout by site, or whether the reported points were separate assemblies.
required_followup: Seek site-level contemporary accounts for attendance and physical boundaries; keep exact timing and multi-site unit unresolved without evidence.
